composers_checked.name: Abel, Carl Friedrich
composers_checked.note: Gap check against the AbelWV list (Güntersberg PDF): WK 227 added. The Berlin, Uppsala, Kammell and Ledenburg trios, the Karlsruhe and Genua trios (manuscripts): no recording surfaced in Apple Music or MusicBrainz searches

note: Floor evidence is commercial recordings found through Apple Music, MusicBrainz, Hyperion and harmonia mundi pages (track lists and credits); no recording means skipped. Keyboard: C.P.E. Bach's keyboard trios and quartets are coded 'piano' (print or manuscript says keyboard/Clavier or 'cembalo ou Piano Forte'; harpsichord as alternative); Abel's Op. 2 says harpsichord only, so it stays 'harpsichord' (formation 'other'). Abel Op. 11 are keyboard concertos with 2 violins and cello (no viola): only No. 2 (WK 54) is kept, on Sonnerie's one-to-a-part recording (Avie AV0014); the other five are skipped because their only recording (CPO, La Stagione Frankfurt) uses triple strings plus violone. Possible false negatives: Abel WK 225/226 (Proprius flute-quartet disc not resolvable), Op. 8 No. 2 (only a flute version recorded), a Güntersberg 2025 edition of Op. 8 was seen only in a search snippet. Not checked: whether C.P.E. Bach's Wq 43 keyboard concertos (H.471-476, 'accompanied by two violins, viola and bass') have one-to-a-part recordings; the Wq 1-47 concertos filed as string orchestra stay out of scope. H.585 is taken as two violins and continuo from the Purcell Quartet's line-up (2 violins, gamba, harpsichord). WK 98 identified with the G-major trio on CPO by its movement list (Moderato, Adagio ma non troppo, Allegretto).
